cand.question: Can Arakelov height bounds h_F(J) >= c * log(max(p, q, r)) be established unconditionally for generalized Frey Jacobians without assuming unproved cases of the Frey-Szpiro or ABC conjectures?
cand.context: Faltings height of Jacobians of cyclic covers degenerates at bad reduction primes, but universal lower bounds across varying signatures are currently conditional on Szpiro or ABC.
